script:
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie>/session --expect 403 --check detail eq 'Origin is not allowed' \
  --check-header set-cookie missing --save F29.session-origin-rules/no-origin
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie>/session --header 'Origin: https://evil.qa.test' --expect 403 \
  --check detail eq 'Origin is not allowed' --check-header set-cookie missing --save F29.session-origin-rules/foreign
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie>/session --header 'Origin: null' --expect 403 --check-header set-cookie missing
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie>/session --header "Origin: $S" --expect 409 \
  --check detail eq 'Canvas App ingress must use a separate browser origin' \
  --check-header set-cookie missing --save F29.session-origin-rules/ingress-origin
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie>/session --header 'Origin: http://127.0.0.1:5173' --expect 200 \
  --check-header set-cookie contains oh_app_backend_session=
